items.colloc: project timeline 專案時程 | strict timeline 嚴格的時程
items.distinct: deadline 截止期限 | milestone 里程碑
ex: The project timeline must be updated before Monday.
專案時程必須在週一之前更新。
We need to establish a realistic production timeline.
我們需要建立一個切合實際的生產時程。
Management approved the proposed timeline yesterday afternoon.
管理階層昨天下午批准了提議的時程。

items.colloc: request an extension 申請展延 | grant an extension 核准延期
items.distinct: expansion 擴充 | delay 耽擱
ex: The team requested an extension on the project.
團隊針對該專案申請了展延。
Her supervisor granted an extension for the final report.
她的主管核准了期末報告的展期。
Clients rarely ask for an extension on payments.
客戶很少要求延後付款期限。

items.colloc: reach a milestone 達成里程碑 | key milestone 關鍵里程碑
items.distinct: objective 目標 | corner 轉角
ex: Reaching this sales milestone boosted team morale significantly.
達成這項銷售里程碑顯著提升了團隊士氣。
The software launch represents a major corporate milestone.
軟體發布代表公司的一大重要里程碑。
Engineers will celebrate their latest development milestone today.
工程師們今天將慶祝最新的開發里程碑。

items.colloc: reschedule a meeting 重新安排會議 | reschedule for 改期至
items.distinct: cancel 取消 | delay 延遲
ex: Could we please reschedule the interview for next Friday?
請問我們可以將面試改期至下週五嗎？
Bad weather forced organizers to reschedule the conference.
惡劣的天氣迫使主辦單位重新安排會議時間。
The director rescheduled our weekly briefing without notice.
主任未事先通知就重新排定了每週簡報。

items.colloc: overdue payment 逾期款項 | long overdue 延誤已久的
items.distinct: expired 過期的（失效） | late 遲到的
ex: The accounting department sent an overdue payment notice.
會計部門寄出了一份逾期款項催繳通知。
This comprehensive system upgrade is already long overdue.
這項全面的系統升級早就該進行了。
Borrowers must return overdue books to the library.
借閱者必須將逾期的書籍歸還圖書館。

items.colloc: for the duration of 在…期間 | short duration 短暫時間
items.distinct: period 時期 | term 任期
ex: Guests must wear badges for the duration of the visit.
訪客在造訪期間必須配戴識別證。
The training program will have a duration of two weeks.
該培訓計畫的持續時間將為期兩週。
Parking fees vary depending on the duration of stay.
停車費用取決於停留的時間長短。

items.pos: n. 進展；進步 | v. 推進
items.colloc: make progress 取得進展 | track progress 追蹤進度
items.distinct: process 流程 | proceed 繼續進行
ex: The construction crew is making steady progress this month.
施工團隊這個月正取得穩定的進展。
Managers meet weekly to track progress on new initiatives.
經理們每週開會以追蹤新計畫的進度。
Technological progress has greatly accelerated our daily workflow.
科技的進步大幅加速了我們的日常工作流程。

items.pos: n. 延誤；耽擱 | v. 延遲
items.colloc: delay in delivery 交貨延誤 | without delay 毫不延遲
items.distinct: defer 推遲 | cancel 取消
ex: Flight delays caused several executives to miss the keynote.
航班延誤導致幾位主管錯過了主題演講。
Please process these urgent shipping forms without delay.
請毫不延誤地處理這些緊急貨運表格。
Supply shortages will definitely delay the product rollout.
供應短缺肯定會延誤這項產品的推出。

items.colloc: upon completion 在完成時 | target completion date 目標完工日
items.distinct: conclusion 結論 | termination 終止
ex: Full payment is due upon completion of the building work.
建築工程全部完工時須付清全額款項。
The target completion date remains the fifteenth of November.
目標完成日期依然維持在十一月十五日。
Workers received bonuses following the successful completion of tasks.
任務順利完成後，員工們獲得了獎金。

items.colloc: urgent matter 緊急事項 | urgent request 緊急請求
items.distinct: critical 關鍵的 | emergent 新興的
ex: The branch manager called an urgent meeting this morning.
分行經理今天早上召開了一次緊急會議。
Please treat this email response as an urgent matter.
請將這封電子郵件的回覆視為緊急事項。
We received an urgent request for additional medical supplies.
我們收到了增援醫療物資的緊急請求。

items.pos: v. 重疊；部分重合 | n. 重疊
items.colloc: schedule overlap 行程重疊 | overlap with 與…重疊
items.distinct: coincide 同時發生 | repeat 重複
ex: Unfortunately, the two seminars overlap by thirty minutes.
不幸的是，這兩場研討會時間重疊了三十分鐘。
Make sure duties do not overlap among department staff.
請確保部門同仁之間的職責沒有相互重疊。
A scheduling overlap prevented her from attending both sessions.
時程重疊使她無法同時參加這兩場會議。

items.pos: n. 階段；時期 | v. 分階段進行
items.colloc: initial phase 初期階段 | phase out 逐步淘汰
items.distinct: stage 階段 | period 時期
ex: The renovation is currently entering its final construction phase.
整修工程目前正邁入最後的施工階段。
We plan to phase out obsolete office equipment soon.
我們計劃很快逐步淘汰過時的辦公設備。
Testing began during the initial phase of software design.
測試工作在軟體設計的初期階段即已展開。

items.pos: adj. 待定的；未決的 | prep. 直到…為止
items.colloc: pending approval 等待批准 | patent pending 專利申請中
items.distinct: suspended 暫停的 | uncertain 不確定的
ex: Your travel reimbursement request remains pending online approval.
您的差旅報銷申請在線上仍處於待核准狀態。
The merger was put on hold pending regulatory review.
在監管機構審查前，該合併案暫時擱置。
Several transactions are still pending verification by the bank.
仍有數筆交易正等待銀行的查核確認。

items.colloc: regular intervals 定期；規則間隔 | time interval 時間間隔
items.distinct: gap 間隙 | pause 暫停
ex: Technicians inspect factory machinery at regular monthly intervals.
技術人員每個月定期檢查工廠的機器設備。
The train leaves the terminal station at twenty-minute intervals.
火車每隔二十分鐘從終點站發車一次。
There will be a brief interval between speaker presentations.
演講者的簡報之間將會有短暫的中場休息。

items.colloc: punctual arrival 準時抵達 | remain punctual 保持準時
items.distinct: prompt 即時的 | timely 及時的
ex: Employees are strongly expected to be punctual for work.
公司強烈要求員工上班必須保持準時。
The express shuttle bus is known for punctual service.
該快捷接駁公車以服務準時而聞名。
Being punctual shows professional respect toward your business partners.
守時展現了對商業合作夥伴的專業尊重。

items.pos: v. 確定優先順序；優先處理
items.zh: 優先處理；劃分優先順序
items.colloc: prioritize tasks 依優先順序排列任務 | prioritize customer needs 優先考慮客戶需求
items.distinct: organize 組織 | prefer 偏好
ex: Effective managers know how to prioritize their daily workloads.
有效率的經理人懂得如何將日常工作劃分優先順序。
Our company will always prioritize product safety over profits.
我們公司將始終優先考慮產品安全而非利潤。
Staff must prioritize resolving urgent client inquiries promptly.
員工必須優先迅速解決客戶的緊急諮詢問題。

items.colloc: within the timeframe 在時間範圍內 | realistic timeframe 合理的時限
items.distinct: deadline 截止日 | timespan 時間跨度
ex: The contractor promised to finish within the agreed timeframe.
承包商承諾在約定的時間範圍之內完工。
Setting a realistic timeframe helps prevent widespread team burnout.
設定合理的時限有助於防止團隊普遍倦怠。
Can we deliver the order within such a short timeframe?
我們能在這麼短的時間範圍內交貨嗎？

items.colloc: suspend operations 暫停營運 | temporarily suspend 暫時中斷
items.distinct: terminate 終止 | pause 暫停
ex: The airline had to suspend flights due to severe blizzards.
航空公司因強烈暴風雪不得不暫停航班。
Management decided to temporarily suspend trading this morning.
管理階層今天早上決定暫時中止交易。
Factory managers suspended assembly line operations for maintenance checks.
工廠經理暫停了裝配線的作業以進行維護檢查。

items.colloc: expedite the process 加速流程 | expedite delivery 加快配送
items.distinct: accelerate 加速 | quicken 變快
ex: Please pay an extra fee to expedite the shipping process.
請支付額外費用以加快貨物配送的流程。
Automation helped expedite order fulfillment in our warehouse.
自動化有助於加速我們倉庫中訂單的履行。
The agency took steps to expedite the visa application review.
該機構採取措施以加快簽證申請的審查。

items.pos: adj. 每季的 | adv. 按季地
items.colloc: quarterly report 季度報告 | quarterly review 季度檢視
items.distinct: annual 年度的 | monthly 每月的
ex: The finance team publishes the quarterly earnings report today.
財務團隊今天發布了季度的財報收益結果。
Board members gather quarterly to discuss major corporate investments.
董事會成員每季集會一次以討論重大企業投資。
Our division achieved its highest quarterly revenue this year.
我們部門創下了今年度最高的單季營業收入。
